name: Drip
label: Drip REST API v2 — subscribers, tags, campaigns, workflows
description: Official Drip REST API v2 at https://api.getdrip.com/v2. Handler: OfficialApiNode. Personal API token as HTTP Basic username (engine encodes {api_token}:{api_token} because the password side cannot be empty). Every path includes {account_id}. trigger.listen is BPMN ingress. Customer owns the Drip account. Minimize subscriber fields. api_token is never logged or returned.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put secrets here. Example: {"operation":"subscriber.upsert"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation when non-blank. EXACT: subscriber.upsert | subscriber.get | subscriber.unsubscribe | subscriber.delete | tag.apply | tag.remove | event.record | campaign.subscribe | campaign.unsubscribe | workflow.activate | trigger.listen. trigger.listen is ingress (BPMN message event, no socket).

schema.label: account_id
schema.description: Drip account id. Required in path; config default allowed.

schema.label: id_or_email
schema.description: Subscriber id or email (path-encoded). Minimize.

schema.label: subscribers
schema.description: One subscriber object escape hatch merged into subscribers[0] (subscriber.upsert / campaign.subscribe). Named email/first_name/last_name win.

schema.label: tags
schema.description: tag.apply one {email,tag} object escape hatch merged into tags[0]. Named email/tag win.

schema.label: tag
schema.description: Tag name. tag.apply → tags[0].tag; tag.remove path {tag}.

schema.label: events
schema.description: event.record one {email,action,properties} object escape hatch merged into events[0].

schema.label: campaign_id
schema.description: Email series campaign id (path or query for unsubscribe).

schema.label: workflow_id
schema.description: Workflow id for workflow.activate.

schema.label: _empty
schema.description: Request-body parameter `_empty` for operations: subscriber.unsubscribe, campaign.unsubscribe, workflow.activate.

schema.label: email
schema.description: Subscriber email. subscriber.upsert / campaign.subscribe → subscribers[0].email; tag.apply → tags[0].email; event.record → events[0].email. Example: ada@example.com.

schema.label: first_name
schema.description: subscriber.upsert first_name. Wired to subscribers[0].first_name.

schema.label: last_name
schema.description: subscriber.upsert last_name. Wired to subscribers[0].last_name.

schema.label: custom_fields
schema.description: subscriber.upsert custom_fields object. Wired to subscribers[0].custom_fields.

schema.label: user_id
schema.description: subscriber.upsert user_id. Wired to subscribers[0].user_id.

schema.label: action
schema.description: event.record action name. Wired to events[0].action. Example: Purchased.

schema.label: properties
schema.description: event.record properties object. Wired to events[0].properties.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Exact 'ok' on HTTP 2xx.

schema.label: HTTP status
schema.description: Upstream status code.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Provider JSON. Log ids only — bodies may contain PII.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT: subscriber.upsert, subscriber.get, subscriber.unsubscribe, subscriber.delete, tag.apply, tag.remove, event.record, campaign.subscribe, campaign.unsubscribe, workflow.activate, trigger.listen.

configurationParameters.label: Api Token
configurationParameters.description: Drip personal API token (Settings → User Info → API Token). HTTP Basic username. Never log or place on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Account Id
configurationParameters.description: Numeric Drip account id (path {account_id} on every call). Also accepted on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout. Positive number; <=0 → 25. Keep below the daemon invoke budget.
